div.h1: Two abstractions, every alphabet — one generic implementation per consumer

p.em: CharUnit types the in-memory edge label · KeyEncoding types the persistent-trie key · both are monomorphized once per alphabet, never re-implemented

div.p: Color key · ⬜ grey = unit/key traits + their concrete impls (the alphabets: u8 · char · u64) · 🟩 green = generic in-memory consumers driven by CharUnit · 🟦 blue = generic persistent overlay consumers driven by KeyEncoding
